judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: This is the primary-nav link to /economy. Its visible text is "Economy" and its aria-label is "Economy sub menu toggle". The destination title is "Economy - Office for National Statistics" and its heading is "Economy". The name starts with the visible label and names exactly that destination, so it matches where the link leads. The live page (checked 2026-10-11, markup unchanged) and the sixteens main.js show that at desktop widths (Rampa used 1280 px) clicking the link navigates to the topic page, and hovering or focusing it opens the flyout submenu and sets aria-expanded. At small widths the click is intercepted to toggle the submenu, and a duplicate link to the topic page is added inside it. So the link's purpose (the Economy topic, with its submenu) can be determined from its name. The words "sub menu toggle" describe the attached submenu. They are imprecise about what a click does at desktop width, which at most is a minor naming (4.1.2) or best-practice note, not a 2.4.4 failure. Rampa had the destination title and still judged that the name does not match it, so the cause is model_error.
